Hey Lisa,

Just wanted to drop you a line and say hi! I noticed something really nice going on in the neighborhood today and thought you’d want to know about it. Right across the street, the Smiths' front yard is absolutely glowing with all the flowers they've planted. It's like a tiny piece of paradise! I was walking the dog and couldn't help but stop and admire all the colors and smells. The geraniums especially caught my eye; they’re such a vibrant red. Plus, it’s made the whole street look so much more inviting and cheerful. 

So thanks for having such good neighbors who take care
